ai.label: AI tools pack
ai.description: Look first at forced ads, opaque credit traps, forced subscription or account, and dormancy. Gacha and P2W do not exist for AI tools, so they are left out of this pack.

media.label: Works pack

gap_report.title: High stars, filtered out
gap_report.note: Items whose store lifetime rating is high but whose Pharos verdict is “filtered out”. v0.5.0 aligns title and verdict: only filtered (avoid) entries appear, while conditional ones stay in the details as conditions and limits. Third-party aggregates such as G2 are never treated as store ratings.
